ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio; approximately 94% high-intensity white pixels to 6% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central region covering >90% of fluke area; bounded by a thin, irregular black perimeter ranging from 5-20 pixels in width; isolated dark circular focal spots observed at approximate relative coordinates (20,25), (41,40), (70,28), and (88,15) on the 2D plane.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 82 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12% of the total vertical bounding box of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations range from 3 to 18 pixels; highest frequency of peaks located on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with initial concavity originating at the median notch transitioning into a pronounced convexity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization; secondary sparse clusters of small dark circular spots visible on the mid-lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and associated calcified scarring at the distal-most points of the left and right fluke lobes.
